title: Biodiversity
group: BIO-EVOL / BIO-ECOL / BIO-PLANT — Evolution, Ecology & Plants
examples: How many different types of life are on Earth?
What are the biggest dangers to plant life today?
Can you explain what a biodiversity hotspot is?

explain.say: Biodiversity means the variety of life on Earth.
This variety is very important for keeping life stable.
A key threat is habitat destruction from human activity.
Another major threat is pollution affecting many species.
Biodiversity hotspots are areas needing urgent protection.

items: High Endemism | Many species found nowhere else

explain.say: In everyday life, healthy forests provide us with clean air to breathe.

draw.text: Real life: Clean air from forests

faq.q: Why is biodiversity important for humans?
faq.a: It provides essential resources like food and medicine for our survival.
asks: What do we gain from having many species?
How does nature support human life?

faq.q: What counts as a biodiversity hotspot?
faq.a: It is a region with a very high concentration of unique species that are under severe threat.

faq.q: What is the biggest threat to plant life?
faq.a: Habitat destruction, which means natural areas are being cleared for building or farming.

faq.q: Does genetic variety count as biodiversity?
faq.a: Yes, it refers to the differences within a single species, which helps it adapt.
asks: What is the difference between species and genetic diversity?
Why is variation inside a species important?

faq.q: Are there any places that are safe from threats?
faq.a: No, almost every area faces some level of threat from human activity.
asks: Is there a place untouched by people?
Can we find any safe zones for wildlife?

facts: Biodiversity includes variety at the genetic, species, and ecosystem levels.
Pollinators, like bees, are crucial for the reproduction of many plants.
Hotspots are areas that have a high level of endemic species.
Habitat destruction reduces the total number of species that can survive.

quiz.say: Which level of biodiversity refers to the variety of genes within one species?
quiz.why: Genetic variety is the differences in genes within a single species, allowing adaptation.

wrong.1: This refers to the number of different species, not the genes inside one.
wrong.2: This describes the different types of habitats, like forests or deserts.
wrong.3: This is a threat, not a level of diversity.

quiz.say: If a region has many unique species but is also heavily threatened, what is it likely to be?
quiz.why: Hotspots are defined by both high biodiversity and high levels of threat.

wrong.0: A stable ecosystem is a result, not the definition of a hotspot.
wrong.1: This only describes the threat, not the high diversity.
wrong.2: This term is not the standard classification for such a region.

quiz.say: What is the main consequence of removing a species from an ecosystem?
quiz.why: Every species plays a role; removing one can cause a chain reaction through the food web.

wrong.0: Most species have roles, and removing them usually causes noticeable problems.
wrong.2: Losing species usually harms the overall balance, not improving oxygen.
wrong.3: Ecosystems take a very long time to recover from major losses.
